messages:
Alex C: kicking off a rapid POC with Delta Systems — they want a 6-week trial, HIPAA-adjacent workload, and clarity on DPA/SOC2 + pen-test expectations. who can map reqs to an onboarding checklist?
Sarah G: I can coordinate the timeline and billing questions. quick Q: are they asking hosted API or dedicated infra?
Alex C: they prefer hosted to start but may request a VPC/Dedicated pool if throughput spikes. main asks: 
- signed DPA before data enters environment
- SOC2 attestation or SOC2 report extract
- optional pen-test window (they'll run an app-level security test)
- HIPAA BA considerations + audit logs
Pranav K: for a hosted POC we can do a scoped DPA + SOC2 summary. pen-test: we usually allow external tests after checklist + contract clauses. timeline estimate: 1) DPA signature (3-5 business days), 2) env prep (2-5 days), 3) pen-test window (we require 48–72h notice + scoped targets).
Maria L (Legal): confirm: Delta wants BA agreement for HIPAA? if yes we need customer-supplied data flow + retention details. also need to route DPA through Legal Ops. I can prep a redlineable DPA template.
Taylor S (SE): technical notes: for HIPAA PII we recommend Dedicated or Private. Hosted is possible with SCIM & KMS separation, but we must limit retained logs. Also need to agree on encryption-at-rest keys (we can offer KMS with customer-managed keys for Dedicated/Private).
Alex C: pricing question from customer: what’s cost for a 6-week POC with 2 concurrent workers ~50 rps and 10k tokens/day avg? they want a quote for hosted vs dedicated burst capacity.
Pranav K: rough hosted estimate: $X/day token + throughput surcharge — I’ll pull numbers and propose a capped POC credit. For dedicated: we can size a small reserved pool (1-2 GPUs) — monthly commit proration for 6 weeks. I’ll include cost-per-1k-tokens and an ops uplift line.
Sarah G: Delta also needs success criteria. They asked for measurable acceptance tests and an eval harness. thoughts?
Taylor S (SE): propose acceptance criteria: 
- Latency: p95 < 300ms for token generation on typical prompts
- Quality: downstream NLU accuracy >= 86% on their labeled set (we run evals)
- Cost: avg cost per 1k tokens below agreed threshold
- Reliability: 99.5% availability during business hours
- Safety: zero high-severity hallucinations for top-50 intents
Pranav K: add an automated eval script we can run daily. sample prompt set and simple scoring harness: 
```
# run_eval.sh (pseudo)
python eval.py --model redwood-hosted:v1 --prompts prompts.json --gold labels.json --metrics accuracy,bleu,f1 --output results.json
```
We can share an eval runner and ingestion instructions.
Alex C: Maria, can we accept pen-test terms where Delta runs only non-destructive tests and shares findings? they want 3rd-party audit included in decision gate.
Maria L (Legal): we can allow a scope-limited pen-test with pre-approved targets and a safe-words list. require an NDA addendum and a vulnerability disclosure flow. they must not probe KMS or underlying infra, only application endpoints.
ops-bot: Deployment guide: https://internal.redwood.io/pocs/quickstart (shared) :link:
Sarah G: timeline proposal: 
Week 0: sign DPA + SOW (3–5 business days)
Week 1: env setup + test data ingest + baseline evals
Weeks 2–4: iterate prompts, run daily evals, customer tests
Week 5: pen-test window (if requested)
Week 6: acceptance run + final report
Alex C: Delta also asked for a SOC2 extract rather than full report. Maria — can we provide an SOC2 summary and auditor contact?
Maria L (Legal): yes we can provide SOC2 Type II coverage summary and an SOC2 letter for the POC team. full reports require NDA but summaries are fine. will attach standard artifact list.
Pranav K: technical blocker: they want per-token cost visibility and token-level provenance in logs. hosted gives token accounting in Console; for dedicated we can enable detailed tracing and export to their SIEM. tradeoff: detailed tracing increases stored log volume (GDPR/HIPAA implications).
Taylor S (SE): compliance note: for GDPR data, we need lawful basis + retention window. we should ask Delta to minimalize PII in test corpus; use synthetic mirrors where possible.
Alex C: can we draft an onboarding checklist and acceptance test plan to send today?
Pranav K: I’ll draft the eval prompts and runner by EOD. sample prompt examples to include: 
- "Given the customer note, extract the required action and due date."
- "Summarize this clinical note into problem/medication list (no PHI retained)."
- "Classify intent from short user queries into 12 intent buckets."
Sarah G: I’ll prep pricing options and an estimate sheet. will include hosted with token cap, dedicated proration, and optional SOC2 artifact fee.
Maria L (Legal): I’ll attach DPA template and SOC2 summary. also adding pen-test addendum + BAA language for HIPAA adjacency.
Alex C: next steps: Sarah to send pricing + timeline, Maria to send DPA + SOC2 summary, Pranav to share eval harness + prompts, Taylor to confirm encryption/KMS options. goal: PRD to customer by EOD tomorrow.
Sarah G: acked. ping me if legal redlines take longer. :thumbsup:
Pranav K: uploading eval skeleton to the thread: https://s3.internal.redwood/pocs/delta/eval-skel.zip
Taylor S (SE): quick infra command for a dedicated test env (internal only):
```
rictl deploy --env dedicated --name delta-poc --region us-west-2 --pool small --kms cmk-aws:key-1234
```
Maria L (Legal): @Alex C please collect their data flow diagram and retention policy before we sign BAA. we also need point of contact for incident response.
Alex C: will collect today and share. thanks all. :eyes:
